summary: Separate legacy no-proof refusals from current nonapplication golden fixtures

replay.detail: Production replay policy is unchanged. Tests retain unknown and no resend when a legacy refusal lacks application proof.

schema.detail: No storage or wire schema changes. The current golden stale-fence envelope carries applied:none; legacy variants explicitly omit proof.

compatibility.detail: Attachment send tests distinguish current explicit nonapplication from legacy stale-fence and derived rate-limited refusals without proof, independent of error code or message.

recovery.detail: Only test coverage changes. Unknown remains non-retryable and explicit applied:none remains the sole basis for preparing a retry.
